annotations.title: Record an application on the person's VH Applications page

description: For a connected person: records an application you made with them, with the resume and cover letter text that was sent, so they can open it when the employer calls. If the person says they applied, record it as applied; add confirmation when you saw the employer's own confirmation words. status ready = documents ready, not applied yet.

access_token.description: Not needed when the person signed in through your Connect / sign-in button (OAuth). Otherwise the access_token from finish_connecting.

confirmation.description: Optional: the employer's confirmation words, verbatim, when seen

cover_text.description: The cover letter as sent, plain text

job_id.description: VeritaHire job id, if the job came from search_live_jobs

resume_text.description: The resume as sent, plain text

name: save_application
title: Record an application on the person's VH Applications page
